title: Social Media App
description: A responsive social media application that uses the Noroff API for authentication, and full CRUD operations on posts.This was my first project with TypeScript, and the UI is styled in plain CSS.

title: Rainy days
description: An e-commerce site and an iteration of an earlier project implementing Vanilla JavaScript, using Noroff's Rainy days API to fetch products. I built the product listing, view one product, cart, checkout flow and the UI is created with basic CSS.
